skill.summary: AI agent for call web search agent strategy tasks

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of call-web-search-agent-strategy skill.

- Provides specialized strategy and workflow for efficient web search agent tasks.
- Enforces strict rules: absolute priority for user input and real-time search results over internal knowledge.
- Implements cost and efficiency controls, including deadlock handling and word count limits.
- Requires in-text inline citation and global bibliography for all sourced information.
- Mandates two-phase workflow: Data Collection (with prioritized tool selection and mandatory logging) and Report Synthesis.
- Includes detailed instructions and role principles to ensure research is user-focused, accurate, and up-to-date.
